I need to drop the entire public schema with CASCADE

To drop the entire public schema with CASCADE in PostgreSQL, you can use the following SQL command:

```sql
DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE;
```

This command will remove the public schema and all objects contained within it. Make sure you have the necessary permissions and that you really want to delete all objects in the schema, as this action cannot be undone.
